title: feat: allow Saauf to publish community models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Add Saauf’s GitHub account to the community-model publisher allowlist.
- No model or pricing changes.

Fixes #15342

gist.headline: One more gardener
gist.blurb: Saauf now has the keys to publish community models. The garden gets another careful pair of hands.
gist.summary: Added Saauf’s GitHub account to the community-model publisher allowlist, enabling them to publish community models without changing existing models or pricing.
gist.impact: Community model users gain access to future models published by Saauf through the existing community-model workflow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli welcoming a new community gardener into a cozy code-garden: a GitHub-style identity badge unlocks a small gate to flower pots containing model cards and sprouting code-plants. Polli wears a tiny gardener hat and hands the new contributor a seed packet, representing trusted publishing access rather than a new model release.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, welcoming a new community gardener through a little unlocked gate into a code-garden of model-card flower pots and sprouting terminal plants; a small GitHub-style badge hangs on the gate. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with subtle pixel-font text: 'PUBLISH'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
